out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. - OBSERVED: the person in charge is not a certified food manager.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM arrived during inspection.

violations.title: Polished/Artificial Nails
violations.observation: Employee with fingernail polish or artificial nails observed handling exposed food while not wearing gloves.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees using fake finger nails or finger nail polish shall always where gloves when handling food.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: - OBSERVED: (1) in-use ice cream scoops were stored in dipper wells with the water not turned on. (2) a cup was used to scoop ice with its handle in touch of ice.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: (1) CFM turned on the dipper wells; (2) CFM relocated the cup.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions. - OBSERVED: the color scale for quaternary ammonia test kit is missing.
violations.corrective_action: - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM ordered a QUATERNARY AMMONIA test kit immediately.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Observed encrusted debris on espresso machine steam wand in front serving area.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. CDI: CFM washed, rinse, and sanitized steam wand.
